title: Essential Steps in Data Preprocessing: Preparing Your Dataset for ML Models

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to the final tutorial of Part One Data Pre-Processing.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到第一部分資料前處理的最後一堂課。

cues.en: We finally completed all the steps that there is to do to prepare any data sets on which we will build our machine learning models.
cues.zh: 我們終於完成準備資料的全部步驟，接下來就能在上面建立模型。

cues.en: And now what we only need to do left is to prepare the data pre-processing template.
cues.zh: 現在只剩下準備資料前處理模板。

cues.en: Because we learned a few stuff.
cues.zh: 因為已經學了不少東西。

cues.en: We learned how to import a data set, to take care of missing data, to encode categorical data, to split the data set into the training set and the test set, and to apply feature scaling to put all
cues.zh: 包括匯入資料集、處理遺漏值、編碼類別資料、切分訓練與測試集，以及用特徵縮放

cues.en: of our variable on the same scale.
cues.zh: 把全部變數調到相同尺度。

cues.en: However, in the data pre-processing template, we're not going to include all of these.
cues.zh: 不過，模板不會包含全部這些步驟。

cues.en: We're only going to include the importing the libraries.
cues.zh: 只保留匯入函式庫。

cues.en: Then of course you need to import the data set.
cues.zh: 當然，也要匯入資料集。

cues.en: Then regarding missing data, I just wanted to show you how to take care of that in case you have some missing data in your data set, you know, in your work.
cues.zh: 遺漏資料的部分，只是教你在工作中遇到這種情況時，該如何處理。

cues.en: So, we are not going to include this in the templates it's just good to know how to take care of this.
cues.zh: 所以不放進模板，但知道做法很重要。

cues.en: But then we will focus on the machine learning models themselves.
cues.zh: 接下來會專注在模型本身。

cues.en: And if in your work experience you encounter missing data, you know how to handle this, any missing data issues.
cues.zh: 以後工作遇到遺漏資料，就知道如何處理各種問題。

cues.en: Then as for categorical data, we won't include it either in the template because we are gonna find very few examples of data where we have to encode the data.
cues.zh: 類別資料也不會放進模板，因為課程中只有少數資料集需要編碼。

cues.en: There will be some examples but we won't include it in the templates because our data sets are gonna be well prepared, so that we can mainly focus on the machine learning models and get the maximum fun.
cues.zh: 雖然會有幾個例子，但資料大多已準備好，讓我們能專注模型本身，享受實作。

cues.en: And then of course, we will include this in the templates, splitting the data set into the training set and the test set, because that's a very important step.
cues.zh: 當然，切分訓練集與測試集會保留，因為非常重要。

cues.en: You need to split your data set between training and test because you need to evaluate your model on a different set than the set on which you built your model.
cues.zh: 必須在與建立模型不同的資料集上評估模型。

cues.en: And feature scaling.
cues.zh: 至於特徵縮放，

cues.en: Okay, so feature scaling, I hesitated to include it in the template, but we are going to include it, only we are gonna put that as comment.
cues.zh: 我原本猶豫要不要保留，最後決定放進模板，但先註解掉。

cues.en: Because you are gonna see that there are several libraries in R in Python and some of them require us to apply feature scaling to the data and some of them don't.
cues.zh: 因為你會看到，R 與 Python 有許多函式庫，有些需要事先縮放，有些不需要。

cues.en: So most of them don't, actually, most of them take care of that for you.
cues.zh: 其實大多數不需要，它們會替你處理。

cues.en: You don't have to do it manually, but you will see that some libraries don't apply the feature scaling.
cues.zh: 不用手動操作，但有些函式庫不會做特徵縮放。

cues.en: I won't tell you which models there are right now, because I will let you find out the surprise, but keep that in mind and you will see that sometimes we will have to use feature scaling.
cues.zh: 現在先不透露哪些模型，讓你之後自己發現，但請記得，有時會需要使用縮放。

cues.en: Okay, so let's start making the templates.
cues.zh: 現在開始製作模板。

cues.en: It's gonna be very quick.
cues.zh: 很快就會完成。

cues.en: Let's do it right now.
cues.zh: 馬上來做。

cues.en: Let's jump to R.
cues.zh: 切回 R。

cues.en: All right, so here is all the steps that we did together.
cues.zh: 這裡是剛才一起做的全部步驟。

cues.en: So importing the dataset, yes, we're keeping it of course.
cues.zh: 匯入資料集，當然保留。

cues.en: Taking care of missing data, that was just to show you, we won't need it in the future.
cues.zh: 處理遺漏值，只是示範，後續課程不需要。

cues.en: So, but you will probably need it in your future, but in the future of this course, we won't need it so we will remove it.
cues.zh: 未來工作可能需要，但這門課接下來不需要，所以刪掉。

cues.en: And coding categorical data, same here.
cues.zh: 類別資料編碼也一樣。

cues.en: We will have to do it once or twice, but not all the time.
cues.zh: 會用一兩次，但不是每次都用。

cues.en: So we will remove it.
cues.zh: 因此刪除。

cues.en: And as I told you, I'm putting this in a separate file so that you can still use it if you need it for your work.
cues.zh: 如前所述，會把完整工具另外存成檔案，需要工作時仍可以使用。

cues.en: Alright, and now I think we have everything.
cues.zh: 好，現在應該都準備好了。

cues.en: Splitting the data set into the training set and test set, of course we're keeping that.
cues.zh: 切分訓練集與測試集，當然保留。

cues.en: And feature scaling, feature scaling as per Python, we're gonna put that in comment.
cues.zh: 特徵縮放，和 Python 一樣，先註解掉。

cues.en: So the three double quotes is not a way to put multi-line comments in R.
cues.zh: R 不能用三個引號來表示多行註解。

cues.en: So unfortunately we cannot do it.
cues.zh: 所以不能這樣做。

cues.en: What we need to do is, this is a good trick, you select the two lines here and then you press command Control+Shift+C
cues.zh: 這裡有個好技巧，選取兩行，再按 Command 或 Control 加 Shift 加 C，

cues.en: and that puts all your lines in comment.
cues.zh: 就能把選取的所有行註解掉。

cues.en: And eventually we'll just add a final touch to this template which is the case where we need to take a subset of our data set.
cues.zh: 最後再補上一種情況：可能需要取資料集的子集。

cues.en: And in that case, we will add the line data set equals then we take the same data set
cues.zh: 這時新增一行，寫 dataset 等於同一份 dataset，

cues.en: and we use the square brackets to select the indexes of the columns we are interested in to build our model.
cues.zh: 再使用方括號，指定建立模型時需要的欄位索引。

cues.en: So let's just put some numbers here and if we need to select specific columns of interest in our future data sets, we will change those indexes.
cues.zh: 先放一些數字，如果未來資料集需要挑選特定欄位，再改這些索引。

cues.en: But for now, let's just put this line in comment.
cues.zh: 目前先把這行也註解掉。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: All right, so the template is really on R as well.
cues.zh: R 的模板也準備完成。

cues.en: We are ready to start our machine learning models.
cues.zh: 可以開始機器學習模型了。

cues.en: You have no idea how I'm excited about that.
cues.zh: 你不知道我有多興奮。

cues.en: I can't wait to show you how it's gonna be a lot of fun.
cues.zh: 迫不及待想展示這有多有趣。

cues.en: We're gonna make awesome predictions.
cues.zh: 我們會做出很棒的預測。

cues.en: You know, we will have some kind of scenarios, business problems and we will have to solve them and we will use the power of machine learning to solve these problems.
cues.zh: 會面對各種情境與商業問題，再利用機器學習的力量解決。

cues.en: You will see how machine learning is powerful.
cues.zh: 你會看到它有多強大。

cues.en: It gives you amazing predictions, amazing results.
cues.zh: 能給你令人驚喜的預測與結果。

cues.en: And keep in mind you will never be lost because we will always know what we're coding.
cues.zh: 也請放心，你不會迷失，因為每次都會清楚知道正在寫什麼。

cues.en: We will always visualize it, there will always be some visual graphics of what we're doing when we make every machine learning model.
cues.zh: 我們會一直視覺化，每個模型都有圖表，呈現正在做的事情。

cues.en: So I can't wait to start this with you.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待想開始。

cues.en: This was the boring part, but the very important part to do.
cues.zh: 這部分比較無聊，但非常重要。

cues.en: So that's great that we did it and now it's time to have fun.
cues.zh: 很高興已經完成，現在該享受樂趣了。

cues.en: So thank you for watching this Data Pre-processing tutorials.
cues.zh: 謝謝觀看資料前處理的這些教學。

cues.en: Congratulations for completing this part.
cues.zh: 恭喜完成這一部分。

cues.en: You are now ready to make machine learning models and I look forward to seeing you in the next part.
cues.zh: 你已經準備好建立模型，期待下一部分見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
